text_markup: The Runner encounters {card:Bullfrog} as the innermost piece of ice protecting a remote server. {card:Bullfrog}'s subroutine resolves and it is moved to be the outermost piece of ice protecting Archives. The Runner is now running on Archives and continues the run from {card:Bullfrog}'s new position.
